messages.author: fe10725826d84d7f
messages.subject: Factor scores from blavInspect()
parts:
Dear all,

I found a discrepancy regarding factor score estimates derived from the lavPredict() and blavInspect() functions.

The estimates of factor scores from lavPredict() using outputs from lavaan and blavaan are very similar. However, they have poor correlations with the posterior mean of factor scores obtained from blavInspect() using the output of blavaan. We used the latest version of lavaan and the GitHub version of blavaan.

# Package versions

packageVersion('blavaan')
0.3.8.513
packageVersion('lavaan')
0.6.5


Below is an illustrative example after some modifications to the example code in the blavaan GitHub website:

https://github.com/ecmerkle/blavaan/blob/master/tests/blavaan_examples.R

rm(list=ls())

library(blavaan)

library(lavaan)

HS.model <- 'visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3

textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6 '

# Model fitting

fitblavaan<- bcfa(HS.model, data=HolzingerSwineford1939,
                          burnin=1000, sample=1000, target="stan",
                         save.lvs=TRUE, n.chains=2)

fitlavaan <- cfa(HS.model, data = HolzingerSwineford1939)



# blavInspect() applied to the blavaan object

bfs <- blavInspect(fitblavaan,"lvmeans")


# lavPredict() applied to the blavaan object

bfs_lavPredict <- lavPredict(fitblavaan,"lv")

# lavPredict() applied to the lavaan object

fs_lavPredict <- lavPredict(fitlavaan, type = "lv")

head(bfs)
head(bfs_lavPredict)
head(fs_lavPredict)


cor(bfs[,1], bfs_lavPredict[,1])
cor(bfs_lavPredict[,1], fs_lavPredict[,1])
cor(bfs[,1], fs_lavPredict[,1])

#----------------- Results-----------------#

head(bfs)

           visual       textual
[1,] -0.9904806 -0.1398672

[2,] -0.6457269 -1.9026200

[3,] -0.4945887 -0.1356137

[4,] -1.2416560 0.6750524

[5,] -0.3828767 0.4183933

[6,] -0.8448696 -0.7858671

head(bfs_lavPredict)

            visual       textual
[1,] -1.00000645 -0.15394226

[2,] -0.09521353 -1.03934284

[3,] -0.68790500 -1.85575251

[4,] 0.55511171 0.02832575

[5,] -0.51631324 -0.13373992

[6,] -0.15099515 -1.36233917

head(fs_lavPredict)

             visual         textual
[1,] -0.8904454 -0.15265788

[2,] -0.1063254 -1.03766873

[3,] -0.6430584 -1.85423553

[4,] 0.5162538 0.03224754

[5,] -0.4853933 -0.13364084

[6,] -0.1606221 -1.36026125


#--------- Correlations----------#
cor(bfs[,1], bfs_lavPredict[,1])
0.1031521

cor(bfs_lavPredict[,1], fs_lavPredict[,1])
0.9997841

cor(bfs[,1], fs_lavPredict[,1])
0.1034387


Kind regards
Mehdi Momen

messages.subject: Re: Factor scores from blavInspect()
parts:
Thanks for the report. It looks like bfs is going across rows instead
of down columns, maybe try

newbfs <- matrix(t(bfs), nrow=301)

to see whether that looks right.

But I haven't been able to replicate this so far on my computer. Could
you send the results of sessionInfo()?

Thanks,
Ed
